target_state.description: A reproducible QA bundle with zero blocking violations, explicit evidence boundaries, and no publication or platform overclaim.
success_criteria: Every plan and OpenSpec acceptance criterion maps to direct current evidence.
Official A2UI processing and A2A lifecycle reuse canonical packages rather than duplicate protocol ownership.
Malformed components, undeclared actions, invalid context, unauthorized actions, and denied approvals fail closed without partially committing an earlier message in the same A2UI batch.
Approved actions enter the command store and update normalized list/detail projections.
Golden fixtures and browser evidence cover happy, denied, malformed, and cancelled behavior without a model key.
Coverage, public ledgers, skills, docs, and retained evidence agree.
Packed consumers, live external agents, non-Chromium browsers, native platforms, and npm publication remain explicitly uncertified.

unknowns: A live external A2A endpoint is configurable but not certified by this keyless gate.
The example resolves workspace source and is not packed-consumer evidence.
Firefox, WebKit, mobile browsers, Flutter, Tauri, and native devices remain outside this change.
The frozen React RC source SHA predates this continuation and remains a separate publication lane.
